widgets.widgetName: Name(s) as shown on tax return
S S N, I T I N, or F E I N (9 digits)

Part I, Line 1. Was this a distribution of a plan participant's entire balance from all of an employer's qualified plans of one kind (pension, profit-sharing, or stock bonus)? If "No," do not use this form
Line 10. Total taxable amount. Subtract line 9 from line 8
Line 11. Current actuarial value of annuity, if applicable, from federal Form 1099-R, box 8. See instructions
Line 12. Adjusted total taxable amount. Add line 10 and line 11. If this amount is $70,000 or more, skip line 13 through line 16, and enter this amount on line 17
Line 13. Multiply line 12 by 50% (.50), but do not enter more than $10,000
Line 14. Subtract $20,000 from line 12 and enter the difference. If the result is zero or less, enter 0
Line 15. Multiply line 14 by 20% (.20)
Line 16. Minimum distribution allowance. Subtract line 15 from line 13
Line 17. Subtract line 16 from line 12
Line 18. Multiply line 17 by 10% (.10)
Line 19. Tax on amount on line 18. Use the Tax Rate Schedule in the instructions
Line 2. Did you roll over any part of the distribution? If "Yes," do not use this form
Line 20. Multiply line 19 by ten (10). If line 11 is blank, skip line 21 through line 26 and enter this amount on line 27. Otherwise, continue to line 21
Line 21. Divide line 11 by line 12 (rounded to at least three places). See instructions
Line 22. Multiply line 16 by the decimal amount on line 21
Line 23. Subtract line 22 from line 11
Line 24. Multiply line 23 by 10% (.10)
Line 25. Tax on amount on line 24. Use the Tax Rate Schedule in the instructions
Line 26. Multiply line 25 by ten (10)
Line 27. Subtract line 26 from line 20

Line 28. Tax on lump-sum distribution. Add Part II, line 7 and Part III, line 27. Enter here and on Form 540, line 34; Form 540NR, line 41; or Form 541, line 21b. Multiple recipients, see instructions
Line 3. Was this distribution paid to you as a beneficiary of a plan participant who was born before January 2, 1936?
Line 4. Were you (a) a plan participant who received this distribution, (b) born before January 2, 1936, and (c) a participant in the plan for at least 5 years before the year of distribution?

Line 5. Did you use Schedule G-1 in a prior year for any distribution received after 1986 for the same plan participant, including yourself, for whom the 2025 distribution was made? If "Yes," do not use this form
Part II, Line 6. Capital gain from federal Form 1099-R, box 3. If you are taking the death benefit exclusion, see instructions

Line 7. Multiply line 6 by 5.5% (.055) and enter here. If you elect to use Part III, go to line 8. Otherwise, enter the amount from line 7 on Form 540, line 34; Form 540NR, line 41; or Form 541, line 21b

Part III, Line 8. If you completed Part II, enter the amount from federal Form 1099-R, box 2a minus box 3. If you did not complete Part II, enter the amount from federal Form 1099-R, box 2a. See instructions
Line 9. Death benefit exclusion for a beneficiary of a plan participant who died before August 21, 1996. See instructions
